body:
Here is a challenge for all you Pvpers out there.

Make a set of iron armor,an iron sword and golden apples No potions or special weapons.
or bows Just straight on sword fighting 

You only have one life.
See how many kills you can get with this setup with out dyeing once.

Post your kills down below

My record is: 213 kills on quintus :D
